name: Buzzalicious
description: Template- and trend-driven social content platform.

APP_URL.description: Absolute base URL of the deployed API, no trailing slash. The Google OAuth callback is derived from it, and redirect URIs must match byte for byte.

WEB_URL.description: Absolute base URL the SPA is served from. Same as APP_URL for the single-deployable topology.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies. At least 32 characters.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts stored credentials. Losing it means every stored OAuth token becomes unreadable.

STORAGE_DRIVER.description: Must be r2 in production — the dyno filesystem is ephemeral.
